note: Follow-up to the 2026-10-24, 2026-10-31 and 2026-11-07 sweeps. The five Scan rows and the BatchGetItem row, checked region by region across the three sweeps and three local runs against every region registry/regions.json lists, from separate processes started at about 18:24, 18:45 and 19:06 UTC. Each local run sends the requests the tests send, at a table that does not exist, because each check fires before the table is looked up. The malformed ExclusiveStartKey needs a real table, so it was sent once per region from a fourth run (local-D, 18:54 to 18:56 UTC) that created and deleted its own temporary tables, and twice more in eu-north-1 (local-E and local-F) after local-D found it on the old wording. A verdict is P when a source gave the pinned region's answer and X when it gave anything else; answer is the exact observation when every local run agreed. me-south-1 did not answer any local run, and no sweep has resolved it. A region moved only where at least two sweeps and every local run agreed on the pinned answer.
